payload.title: Create Route 53 hosted zone and delegate chattic.us name servers
payload.description:
CDK stack (shared, e.g. ChatticusDns): Route 53 public hosted zone for chattic.us.

At the domain registrar, replace the current name servers with the four NS records Route 53 assigns. This is a one-time manual step outside AWS; document the registrar steps in infra/README.md.

Include staging/dev subdomains in the zone (e.g. staging.chattic.us, dev.chattic.us) or document that non-production web uses distribution URLs until custom DNS is needed.
